inlineSnapshotSource.temperatureReason: Canonical (stale installed source) fallback of the HOT project/initiative point readers.
inlineSnapshotSource.reason: Only when the reader's SQL snapshot keeps a consulted collection inline (duplicate, empty or over-long IDs leave it without per-record rows), the canonical point reads answer from that snapshot's validated, normalized logical source through the existing installed readers instead of row-by-row SQL that cannot see inline entries. The parser holds its own lease and normalization admits its retained base, as reloadResidentWorkspace; the source is request-owned and released by Close. Row-backed workspaces keep the unchanged canonical SQL path. SW540 compares the hydrated literal copy with bounded warm and stale-source (canonical) BeginResourceRead/BeginResourceAuthorizationRead over inline duplicate projects, initiatives and initiative relations, owner/member/guest and unrestricted/selected/app keys, with zero full decodes and released work; it fails without the fallback (the canonical path answered not found).
